ModMetaData.name: No Caves - Continued
ModMetaData.author: sayhiben
ModMetaData.description:
Prevents RimWorld's vanilla cave generation utility from carving cave tunnels and suppresses its vanilla cave-map query. Includes RimWorld 1.6 support and a 1.7 alpha candidate, in respect of kd8lvt's original NoCaves mod and maintenance handoff. Controlled cave-suppression tests pass on both versions; broader compatibility checks remain pending.
AI assistance: OpenAI Codex was used to write and revise code, tests, documentation, and deployment automation, and to operate the game for controlled tests during this continuation's RimWorld 1.7 uplift.
